'''Caulbon''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Caulbon system/Legends|Caulbon system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Around [[17,000 BBY]], it was situated outside of the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was a part of [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]], territory that fell under the control of the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="EGTW" /> of the [[Giju system/Legends|Giju system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

After its restoration around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the Republic moved aggressively beyond that Republic's frontier to defend its [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] and commerce. Although few records survived from that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Music/Legends|songs]] continued to mention deeds of bravery committed by members of the Republic Navy during conflicts at Caulbon, [[Esaga]], and [[The Sundered Veil/Legends|the Sundered Veil]]. Around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] to [[11,000 BBY]], Caulbon had been incorporated into the Republic.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caulbon was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Caulbon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
